description: Authorized RF/SDR security research on non-Wi-Fi radio signals — identify a signal's frequency and modulation receive-only, demodulate and reverse the protocol, and assess replay feasibility in a shielded lab. Load for wireless remotes, key fobs, sensors, telemetry, ISM-band devices, ADS-B, or any sub-GHz/RF protocol outside classic Wi-Fi. Signals: unknown RF device in scope, 315/433/868/915 MHz, OOK/ASK/FSK captures, RTL-SDR/HackRF work.
